title: Asymptotic-Möbius maps
summary: We introduce asymptotic-Möbius (AM) maps, a large-scale analogue of quasi-Möbius maps tailored to geometric group theory. AM-maps capture coarse cross-ratio behavior for configurations of points that lie far apart, providing a notion of "conformality at infinity" that is stable under quasi-isometries, compatible with scaling limits, and rigid enough to yield structural consequences absent from Pansu's notion of large-scale conformality. We establish basic properties of AM-maps, give several sources of examples, including quasi-isometries, sublinear bi-Lipschitz equivalences, snowflaking, and…
